caseNameFull: Jones v. Suter, Clerk, Supreme Court of the United States

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. See this Court’s Rule 39.8. Petitioner is allowed until June 22, 1993, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court. Justice Stevens would deny the petition for writ of certiorari.
